description: For a developer tool (product name or npm package, e.g. 'Clerk', 'next-auth', '@supabase/supabase-js'), returns how often 6 AI models recommend it first, mention it, and actually use it in apps they build, with its rank and main competitor. Covers auth, databases and email.
name: get_tool_pick_rate
title: How AI models pick a developer tool
